question: Figures X, Y and Z show the sagittal sections (the plane which divides the body into left and right parts) of a frog embryo from the surface to the depth, respectively. Figures a–d are cross sections of the same embryo shown in Figure Z.
question_zh: 图 X、Y、Z 分别显示蛙胚从表面到深部的矢状切面（将身体分为左右两部分的平面）。图 a–d 是图 Z 所示同一胚胎的横切面。

images.caption: Sagittal sections X, Y, Z of a frog embryo and cross sections a–d. Dashed lines 1–4 on Z indicate the levels of the cross sections.
images.caption_zh: 蛙胚矢状切面 X、Y、Z 及横切面 a–d。Z 上的虚线 1–4 表示横切面所在位置。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Figure “a” is the cross section from region “1”.

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Figure “b” is the cross section from region “3”.

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Figure “c” is the cross section from region “4”.

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Figure “d” is the cross section from region “2”.

explanation:
A【错】图 a 中央有宽大的咽腔，属于咽部区域 2，而不是头部区域 1。
B【对】图 b 显示神经管、脊索和较小的肠腔，是躯干中段区域 3 的横切面。
C【对】图 c 显示较小的神经管、脊索而缺乏宽大咽腔，属于尾端区域 4。
D【错】图 d 两侧有大型圆形结构（眼/听囊），应属头部区域 1，而不是区域 2。
